title: Thai Ginger Chicken (Gai Pad King)
description: Make your own restaurant-quality ginger chicken at home with this flavorful recipe.
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into thin strips
1 large red bell pepper, cut into strips
0.5 cup fresh ginger, cut into matchsticks
0.5 teaspoon Thai red chile paste, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring water and rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice tender and water has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.

Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and garlic; cook 2 minutes. Add green onions, bell pepper, mushrooms, ginger, fish sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar; cook and stir until chicken no longer pink and vegetables nearly tender, about 3 minutes. Whisk chili paste into chicken broth in a small bowl until dissolved; add to wok. Season with salt and black pepper. Garnish with cilantro leaves; serve with rice.
